validationContract.model: schedule_row_tile over offsets 32 experts at a time, then the kernel's aligned, partial-row, partial-column or partial branch with BlockLoader, the affine QuantizedBlockLoader and float32 products per block of K and the partial block when align_K is false, against direct dot products of the dequantized weights

functionConstants.reached: groups of 32 or more align the quantized dimension, K for nt and N for nn

validationContract.routing: GatherQMM with M == 1, B >= 16, sorted rhs indices and B / E >= 4; nt on devices without NAX kernels
validationContract.inputs: activations in [-1, 1] in steps of 1/4, every code of each group with 0 and the top code, scales of +-2^-j for j < 4 and biases of -c * scale
validationContract.exactness: every dequantized weight is exact in the element type and every partial sum a multiple of 2^-5 below 2^19; only static_cast<T> rounds, to nearest even
validationContract.guards: 8 guards after every buffer; y's must stay untouched and no loader reads them
validationContract.openglIndexRangeAssertions: x vectors, resource helper elements, weight bytes and offsets fit 32-bit indices; tile slots stay in their tiles
validationContract.metalUpstreamComparison: the unchanged upstream kernel with the same function constants, word for word
